title: Stormy Rescue
moral: Being brave and helping others is important.

scenes.summary: Captain Jack sails to help a ship in trouble.
scenes.text: Captain Jack and his crew set out to help a ship that needed rescue.
scenes.image_prompt: pirate captain spotting ship in trouble ocean cartoon style
scenes.story: Captain Jack sailed to rescue a ship in trouble. A storm came, but he stayed brave and led his crew through it. They rescued everyone safely and returned home as heroes. Captain Jack reminded everyone that being brave and kind is most important.
